name: fabriciq
description: > Answer natural-language business questions over existing Power BI reports and dashboards through the FabricIQ MCP endpoint. Orchestrates artifact discovery, schema inspection, entity resolution, DAX generation, and query execution to return plain-language answers. Use when the user asks what, which, compare, rank, explain, or summarize questions about Power BI report or dashboard content. Triggers: "ask power bi", "PBI question", "discover my Power BI report", "report data", "dashboard data",
author: microsoft
summary_zh: 通过自然语言查询现有 Power BI 报表和仪表盘，自动生成并执行 DAX，适合数据对比、排名、解释和汇总。
